Commentary.Commentary: That will be it from today. India start off the World Cup with a bang as they have defeated the hosts. On Saturday, 22nd February, it will be a double-header as West Indies will take on Thailand in the first game at 1500 Local (0700 GMT). It will be followed by New Zealand taking on Sri Lanka at 1900 Local (1100 GMT). Till then, cheers and take care!

The Indian skipper, Harmanpreet Kaur, says that this is a great start for the team. Says that they were just looking to do well with the bat and put a score of around 140 on the board. Mentions that the partnership between Deepti Sharma and Jemimah Rodrigues was pivotal and that the track was on the slower side. Credits Poonam Yadav with leading the bowling attack and the way she has recovered from the injury.

The Australian skipper, Meg Lanning, says that the bowlers did a very good job to restrict the Indian batters. Adds that the batters failed tonight and a lack of partnerships hurt them in the end. Credits the Indian bowlers for the way they bowled. Adds that they came into this match well prepared and now they will assess this game and will be looking forward to the next game. Ends by saying that they have to win their remaining games and look to go further in the tournament.

Poonam Yadav collects the Player of the Match award. On being asked about her recovery, she thanks her teammates and the physios who have always encouraged and helped her. Says that the first time she bowled here it was against the Australians and she wanted to do well again tonight. Says that this is the third time that she has missed out on a hat-trick but she wants to do well for the team and is pleased with her performance today.

Earlier in the game, after being asked to bat first, India managed to put on a decent total after good efforts from Shafali Verma, Jemimah Rodrigues and Deepti Sharma. The total could've been even bigger but the Aussie bowlers pulled things back after the early assault from teenager Verma. Eventually, the total ended up being a pretty good one as the Indians managed to keep the Aussies at bay and win the opening game of the tournament by defeating the reigning World Champions, Australia. Stay tuned for the presentation.

Like India, Australia started well with the bat. However, introduction of Poonam Yadav saw wickets fall quickly and run-scoring getting difficult. She troubled one and all with her flighted deliveries and ended with a 4-fer. It could've easily been a fifer with a hat-trick but Bhatia put down a chance but that didn't trouble India as they rolled over the Aussies. Shikha Pandey was the one who removed the first wicket and she was excellent in her spell, picking up 3 wickets for 14 runs.

The run chase started brilliantly for the Aussies and Healy took the attack to the opposition. She was playing brilliantly but she had to do all the job alone as others around her could not contribute much. Apart from Healy's half ton and the fight from  Ashleigh Gardner, none of the Aussie batters could enter into the two-figure mark and it should be enough to describe the batting by the hosts.

Wow! What a brilliant start to the tournament and it is India who edge over Australia, the hosts, in this excellent game. Poonam Yadav was all over the Aussies with her flighted deliveries and her 4-fer saw them crumble after having a great start provided by Healy.

OUT! RUN OUT! That is all over and Australia are thumped in the tournament opener. Fuller ball around off, Schutt pushes it towards sweeper cover. They take the first run and go for the second. Rodrigues in the deep fires a throw at the non-striker's end. Pandey collects the ball and whips the bails off to catch Strano short. INDIA WIN BY 17 RUNS!
Just a run now! Length ball outside off, Strano pushes it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Brilliant yorker! It is on middle, Strano can only dig it back to the bowler.
Megan Schutt is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT & BOWLED! Australia are 9 down now and their only hope, Gardner departs. A high full toss around off, Gardner looks to slam it over deep mid-wicket but ends up mistiming it high in the air. Pandey settles herself under the ball and pouches it with ease.

NOT OUT! The ball bounced well in front of the keeper. A length ball outside off, Strano looks to reach out and drive but gets an outside edge. The ball goes behind and Bhatia collects it. The batters go for the quick run. The umpires get together and want to check if the ball went to Bhatia on the full. The soft signal is not out. The replays roll in and show that it bounced just in front of the gloves of the keeper.

Is that another wicket for India? The umpire gets together once again takes the decision upstairs. This time it is for a caught behind. Did the ball carry to the keeper there? No, just bounced before the gloves of Bhatia.
Shikha Pandey to bowl the final over of the match.
Good ball to end the over! Tossed up delivery way outside off, it stays low after pitching. Gardner looks to pull but misses. 20 runs needed off the last over.
FOUR! Bad bowling! Floated shortish delivery on middle, Gardner rocks back and pulls this one towards the mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Molly Strano is the next batter in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Delissa Kimmince walks back now and Australia go further down the barrel. It is a wonderful throw from the deep by Jemimah Rodrigues. Shortish delivery outside off, Gardner rocks back and pulls this one towards mid-wicket. The batters set off for two. Gardner completes the first and calls her partner for the second. Kimmince obliges but Rodrigues collects the ball in the deep and fires a flat and fast throw at the non-striker's end where Deepti Sharma takes the bails off. Kimmince walks back now and the Indian team is in full celebratory mood.
Good length ball outside off now, Gardner looks to hoick this one towards the leg side but misses it completely.
Good length ball on the pads, Gardner looks to flick but misses.
Good fielding by Veda Krishnamurthy! Full ball on middle and leg, Kimmince pushes it towards mid-wicket and sets off for two. However, Veda rushes in from the deep and keeps it down to a single.
Deepti Sharma to bowl the penultimate over of the match. 3-0-11-0 are her figures so far.
Shorter and on middle, Kimmince goes for the reverse sweep and works it towards point. A run taken. 27 needed off the final 2 overs.
Loopy ball outside off, Gardner comes down the track and looks to slog but mistimes it towards long on for a run.
Quicker one on middle, Gardner does well to force it towards covers.
Fuller and on the pads, flicked to the mid-wicket fielder. Nothing off the Free Hit.

NO BALL! NOT OUT! Gardner has been bowled as the ball hit her legs and then the stumps behind her, but the umpire has ruled this out as an illegal delivery. It is a loopy ball again from Poonam, Gardner comes down the track and looks to slog but misses. The ball hits her pad and rolls to hit the stumps. But before the Indians can celebrate, the umpires get together and refer it upstairs. The replays show that the ball bounced twice before it reached the popping crease and hence it has been given as a No Ball. Also, a Free Hit given to rub salt into the wounds of the Indian players.

Bowled? Safe? The umpires have referred a decision upstairs. The ball has hit the stumps off the pads of Gardner but it has bounced twice before it reached the popping crease. So, not out and a Free Hit for Australia.
Flatter and around off, Gardner cuts but finds the fielder at point.
Slower through the air outside off, Kimmince waits and pushes it down to long on for a run.
Poonam Yadav is back on. 3-0-15-4 are her figures so far.
Full and outside off, Gardner throws her bat at it but fails to connect. End of an excellent over from Pandey. 31 needed off the final 3 overs.
Full and just outside off, Kimmince drives it towards long off for a single.
Length ball on off, it is pushed back to the bowler.
Delissa Kimmince is the new batter in.

OUT! STUMPED! Australia lose their seventh wicket and this time it is Shikha Pandey who has struck. Length delivery on off, Sutherland looks to come down the track and strike it over the bowler but misses the ball completely. The ball goes towards Bhatia who collects the ball and whips the bails off in a flash to send Sutherland packing. The match is surely tilted towards India now and Australia have shot themselves in the foot after a good start.
Full delivery on middle, Gardner drives it through mid on for a single.
On a good length on middle, Gardner looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Shikha Pandey is back on. 2-0-9-1 are her figures so far.
Flatter one on middle, pushed to long on for a single.
SIX! Massive! Gardner is keeping Australia in the game and this one should  release some pressure. A full ball in the slot, Gardner slams it over the long on fence for a huge maximum.
On the pads, this is worked towards mid-wicket.
Loopy ball on off, Sutherland comes down the track and lofts it over mid off for a run.
Flatter and around off, pushed towards sweeper cover for a run.
Short and outside off, Sutherland cuts but finds the point fielder.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad is back on. 3-0-22-1 are her figures so far.
Length ball around off, pushed back to the bowler. Australia need 42 runs in 30 balls to win the match.
Shortish and around off, Gardner punches it to deep point for a single.

NOT OUT! Excellent running between the wickets. Length ball around off, Gardner tucks it towards deep square leg and calls for two straightaway. The fielder fires the throw at the keeper's end who collects the ball and whips the bails off. The square leg umpire refers it upstairs.
Run out appeal taken upstairs. Looks like Gardner has dragged the bat inside the crease in time. Yes, she has.
Length ball on off, forced to long off for an easy single.
Shortish and around off, slapped towards mid off for a quick run.

FOUR! Flicked off the pads. Vital boundary. Reddy bowls this fuller ball on the pads, Gardner whips it towards deep square leg. The fielder from deep mid-wicket runs to her right and tries to make a diving stop but she misses.
Beaten! That wasn't too far away from getting an inside edge. Another tossed up ball outside off, this one turns in as Sutherland tries to defend. Just a run and a wicket.
Annabel Sutherland is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Another one bites the dust and once again it is Poonam Yadav who is running through this Australian batting order. Another ball which is slower through the air and just outside off, Jonassen looks to pull but the ball takes a thin under edge and goes behind. Bhatia behind the wickets makes no mistake this time. The Indians are delighted and the Australians are bleeding here.
Loopy ball on middle, Jonassen comes down the track and looks to defend but the ball takes the inside edge and hits the pads.
Flatter and outside off, this time Gardner forces it to sweeper cover for a single.
Another slower one. It is in the line of the stumps. Gardner does well to get his bat down in time to force it towards covers again.
Slower through the air outside off, Gardner waits for it and then pushes it towards covers.
Full delivery on middle, Gardner flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
On a length on off, Jonassen punches it towards long off for a single.
On a good length on middle, Gardner looks to flick but gets an inside edge. It goes towards the leg side. The batsmen take a run.
Length delivery outside off, Jonassen punches it through covers. The batsmen cross ends.
On a length on off, Gardner punches it towards point for a single.
Full delivery on off, Gardner drives it to covers.
Floated and around off, Jonassen comes forward and keeps it out. End of an excellent over from Poonam. 5 runs and 2 wickets off it. Could've easily been three there but not to be.

Dropped! Oh dear, Bhatia drops a sitter! No hat-trick for Poonam Yadav and she really deserved it. That was a straightforward chance there as Poonam deceives another batter with the flight on the ball. She lands this one just outside off, Jonassen is drawn forward. The ball takes the outside edge and goes behind. Bhatia moves to her left and tries to catch but fails to hang on. Skipper Kaur is there at first slip and she could've swallowed it easily. Poonam is disappointed that she didn't get the hat-trick. Will this come to bite India back?
Jess Jonassen is the new batter in. She will be facing the hat-trick ball.

OUT! BOWLED! Two in two and it is the mighty wicket of Perry. Poonam Yadav is on fire here! What a ball to knock over the best batter going around the world. Yadav once gives this ball a lot of air. She lands it on middle and leg, Perry comes down the track and looks to push at it but is way early in the shot. It is a googly and Perry misses and the ball goes behind to hit the leg pole. Poonam celebrates and she is on a hat-trick now.
Ellyse Perry walks in now.

OUT! STUMPED! Yadav strikes again and it is once again the flighted delivery that strikes gold for Poonam. Excellent bowling from her. Poonam bowls this ball just outside off, Haynes charges down the track and looks to force the ball towards the off side but the ball turns away from her. It goes low to the keeper, Bhatia, who does well to bend down and whip the bails off in a flash. India are right back in this game.
Shortish and around off, Gardner punches it towards extra cover for a run.
FOUR! Up and over! Yadav bowls a very flighted delivery but it is way outside off, Gardner skips down the track and slams it between the gap at long off and sweeper cover for a boundary.
Short and outside off, Gardner forces it towards wide mid off for a single.
Landed around off on a length, Haynes eases a single down to long on.
Good length ball around off, Gardner forces it to wide long on and gets to the other end.
Length ball on off, pushed towards extra cover.
Another length ball around off, Haynes works it towards mid-wicket and takes a quick run.
Length ball around off and middle, Haynes comes down the track and keeps it out.
Arundhati Reddy is back on. 1-0-15-0 are her figures so far.
Shortish and around off, cut to the point fielder. 66 needed off 60 balls now.
Ashleigh Gardner is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Fifty and gone! Brilliant from Poonam. She deceives Healy with the flight of the ball here. A tossed up ball around off, Healy comes down the track and looks to loft it but because of the slowness of the delivery, ends up chipping it back to the bowler. Poonam moves a little to her right and pouches it with ease. A huge wicket for India and two new batters will be at the crease now. Can India drag it back from here?

SIX! FIFTY FOR HEALY. Excellent innings from her so far. She gets there as Poonam offers her a gift. A high full toss on the pads, Healy charges down the track and sends it sailing over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. She will look to take Australia home in this run chase.
Another full toss for the left-hander, Haynes once again forces it to long off for a run.
Full and around off, Healy strokes it to long off for a single.
Full toss outside off, Haynes pushes it to long off for a run.
Poonam Yadav comes on to bowl now.
On off, pushed to long on for a run.
Floated on middle, Healy charges down the track and lofts it over the bowler.  Deepti there first tries to catch the ball but then stops and decides to collect it on the bounce. A run taken.
Shortish and around off, Haynes pushes it towards covers and a run is taken. She is off the mark straightaway.
Rachael Haynes walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Gayakwad strikes and sends the Aussie skipper packing. Gayakwad bowls a loopy ball around off, Lanning comes down the track but the ball pitches and turns away. Bhatia collects the ball and tries to whip the bails off but she misses. However, she appeals for a caught behind. The umpire takes her time and then raises her finger. Lanning does not wait then and starts walking. Brilliant delivery from Gayakwad as she beats Lanning with the flight on the delivery. A lucky break for Bhatia though one can say as she missed an easy stumping.
Short one around middle, it is pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller ball outside off, Healy comes down the track and lofts it over mid off. Deepti at long off fails to pick the ball clearly and that allows the batters to return for an extra run.
Good length ball on middle and leg, pushed down to long on for a single. Potentially a game-changing over as 15 runs come off it.

FOUR! Consecutive boundaries and third of the over. This time Healy comes down the track and converts this one into a full toss. The ball falls just inside the fence at long on and a boundary results.
FOUR! Another boundary! Back of a length ball on off, Healy rocks back and cuts this one fine beating the fielder at backward point inside the circle for a boundary.
Another length ball on off, cut towards backward point. Gayakwad there misfields and allows the batters to take a single.
Length ball on off, pushed towards cover-point for one.
FOUR! Welcome into the attack, Reddy! A shortish ball on middle and leg, Healy rocks back and pulls this one towards mid-wicket for a boundary.
Arundhati Reddy comes on to bowl now.
Shortish and outside off, Lanning cuts it well but Shafali Verma at point makes a diving stop to her left.
Full and around off, Healy comes down the track and strokes it to long on for a single.

NOT OUT! Healy makes her ground well in time. A floated ball outside off, Lanning looks to push it towards covers but the ball takes the outside edge and goes to short third man. The batters take off for the run. The short third man fielder fires the throw at the striker's end where the keeper whips the bails off. The Indians appeal and the third umpire has been called in. The replays roll in and show that Healy has dragged her bat in.
Run out appeal taken upstairs.
Full and outside off, Lanning slams it past point and bags a couple before the sweeper cover fielder can get to the ball.
Shortish and around off, Lanning pushes it towards point.
Full and around off, Lanning pushes it towards mid off.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad is back on! 1-0-12-0 are her figures so far.
Short and outside off, Healy cuts but can't beat the point fielder. End of a successful over from Pandey. Australia end the Powerplay on 33/1.
Full and around off, Lanning squeezes it out towards point where the point fielder fumbles and allows a run.
Skipper, Meg Lanning, walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Pandey draws first blood. It is Mooney who departs. A short of a length ball outside off, Mooney looks to cut but ends up slicing it towards point where Gayakwad comfortably pouches it to break the opening stand. 101 more needed in 86 balls.
Good length ball on middle, Healy eases a single down to long on.
Fuller and around off, Healy finds the cover fielder to her drive.
Good length ball around off, Mooney comes down the track and whips it to long on for a run.
Full and outside off, Healy drives but finds mid off. Another tight over from Deepti Sharma.
Flatter and around off, Mooney tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on middle, Healy pushes it towards long on for a single.

Quick run! Sharma bowls this one slower through the air and around the pads, Mooney comes down the track and looks to defend but the ball takes an inside edge onto the pads. It goes towards short third man for a single.
Full and around off, Healy comes down the track and pushes it down to long on for a run.
Loopy ball on the pads, Mooney comes down the track and strokes it towards long on for a run.
Length ball on middle, forced towards mid on.

FOUR! Drilled down the ground! This is excellent batting from Healy. She is taking the attack to the opposition here. A length ball around off, Healy launches it over the bowler's head and the ball races away to the fence.
Short and outside off again, Healy cuts but finds the point fielder.
Good length ball just outside off, Healy goes on the back foot and slaps it past the point fielder. Before the third man fielder can come across, a couple of runs taken.
Length ball on middle, Healy pushes it towards mid on.
Good length ball just around off, Healy looks to drive but misses.
Shikha Pandey is on now!
Full and on middle, Healy comes down the track and strokes it to long on for a run.
On middle, Healy comes forward and defends it out.
Flatter and outside off, Healy looks to cut but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Full on the pads, Mooney looks to flick but misses again. The ball rolls towards mid-wicket and a leg bye is taken.

NOT OUT! Poor, poor review from the Indians. Shortish in length and down the leg side. Mooney looks to pull but misses to get hit on the pads. The Indians appeal but not out says the umpire. The fielders discuss and go for the DRS at the last moment. The Ultra Edge shows no bat. Where is it pitching? Way down the leg side. So, India waste a review.
Review time! Mooney is the batter in question. It looks like the ball has pitched outside leg and yes, the replays confirm it. Review wasted!
Loopy fuller ball outside off, Mooney drives it uppishly towards mid off.
Quicker one on the pads, pushed to long on for a run. Excellent over for Australia, 12 from it.
On the pads, Healy strokes it towards long on for a run.
Flatter and just outside off, Healy looks to force it on the off side but misses.
Up and over! Full and just around off, Healy backs away and opens up the off side field and lofts it over extra cover for a boundary.

Full and on middle, Healy pushes it towards covers where Rodrigues makes a diving save but can't stop the run. She fires the throw at the non-striker's end. The bowler fails to collect and extra run is taken.
FOUR! Flicked off the pads! Shortish and on the pads of Healy, she flicks it past Shikha at square leg. She chases the ball but comes second. First boundary of the innings.

Spin from the other end too as Rajeshwari Gayakwad is into the attack. And yes, Smriti Mandhana is going into the pavilion. The Indian team will be hoping that this is a precautionary measure more than anything else and that their star batter is alright.
Down the leg side, Mooney looks to flick this one but misses and is hit on the pads. The Indian players appeal but it is clearly pitching outside leg.

Superb effort by Smriti Mandhana but she has hurt herself in the process. Shortish ball on off, Healy rocks back and cuts this one towards cover-point. Mandhana gives it the chase and pulls the ball back before crashing into the advertising boards. She is seen holding her left shoulder and she is clearly in pain. It is unclear whether she has saved the boundary or not. The umpire refers it upstairs and the replays show that Mandhana has saved a run for her side. She is still holding her left shoulder as she comes onto the field. Her fitness will be a cause of concern for the Indian team.
Shortish ball on middle, punched towards cover again. Again the fielder at cover dives but this time only a half-stop by her and a single results.
Floated ball on off, Mooney pushes this towards the fielder at cover who dives and does well to stop a single.
Bowls a quicker one on the pads, Healy tucks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Deepti starts with a loopy ball around off, Healy comes forward and defends it out.

We are back for the run chase. The Indian players take their positions in the field. The two Aussie openers, Alyssa Healy and Beth Mooney, walk out to the middle too. Deepti Sharma with the ball first up. Here we go...
